title: KittyTown
description: A little mod who help KittyTeam's server
body:
### KittyTeam Official Mod, Modpack, ressource pack and Datapack
____________________________________
These packs have been specially created to enhance your experience on the KittyTeam server. 🎮 Whether you're a new player or a veteran, the mod, modpack, resource pack, and datapack bring a variety of improvements to make your gameplay smoother, more immersive, and more fun! 🚀

> Mod: Adds new features and optimizations to improve server performance and mechanics.

> Modpack: Curated with the best mods to give you a complete, balanced experience.

> Resource Pack: Visual upgrades that bring more life to the game with custom textures and designs.

> Datapack: Extra functionality and game rules to enhance your adventures on the server.

With all of these combined, you're in for an unforgettable gaming experience on KittyTeam! 🐾
### KittyTeam Mod Features ✨
____________________________________

Gameplay Improvements: New tools and features to facilitate resource management and game organization.

Customization: Adapt certain game mechanics to better match your playstyle or the needs of the server.

### 🚀 Fabric Installation Guide on Modrinth (with Fabric API) for KittyTeam Server 🐾
____________________________________

Download Fabric Installer
Go to the official Fabric website to download the installer:

Link to Fabric Installer
Installing Fabric

Run the Fabric installer.
Select the version of Minecraft you want to use (make sure it is compatible with your mod).
Click "Install" to complete the installation. Once finished, the Fabric profile will be added to your Minecraft launcher.
Download Fabric API
The Fabric API is essential for your mod to work properly:

Go to Modrinth and download the Fabric API here:
Fabric API on Modrinth
Move the downloaded file to the Minecraft mods folder:
C:\Users\[your-username]\AppData\Roaming\.minecraft\mods (Windows)
Download and install your mod

Go to your mod page on Modrinth.
Download the latest version of your mod and also place it in the mods folder in the location described above.
Launch Minecraft with Fabric

Open your Minecraft launcher.
Select the Fabric profile (created automatically during installation).

or use Modrinth
